positions.commentary: Google Cloud has grown from $4 billion in revenue in 2017 to a successful business under new leadership.

thesis: This episode argues that Google is positioned to win a capital-intensive race in business history by leveraging its core search advertising business and substantial cash reserves. Additionally, it posits that the company has successfully transformed its cloud division into a scalable infrastructure-as-service model, driving significant revenue growth under new leadership.

claims.claim: Google intends to win the capital-intense race in business history with its core search ads business and extra cash.
claims.quote: That illustrates what a crazy business their core search ads business is. And we have tons of extra cash lying around on top of what we think, plus a safety cushion for investing in that CapEx race.

claims.claim: Google has transformed its cloud business from an opinionated platform to an infrastructure-as-service model, similar to AWS.
claims.quote: What they're still doing today, which the whole world eventually realized was right, which is cloud should be Infrastructure as a Service.
